headline: 6 fire engines deployed as fire breaks out at Centrepoint mall in Uttara
summary: The blaze reportedly started in a fourth-floor restaurant and was brought under control within an hour.
details: A fire broke out at the Centrepoint shopping mall near Dhaka airport this afternoon.
The blaze reportedly originated at a restaurant located on the fourth floor of the mall.
Upon receiving the information around 12:45 pm, six fire engines were rushed to the scene to combat the fire.
According to Talha Bin Jasim, an official of the Fire Service and Civil Defence media wing, the blaze was brought under control by 1:40 pm.
The cause of the fire has not been immediately known.

headline_marked: [[Two soldiers killed]] in Bangladesh army tank firing accident in Hathazari
headline: Two soldiers killed in Bangladesh army tank firing accident in Hathazari
summary: An accidental explosion or mechanical failure during a routine field firing exercise at the Hathazari range resulted in the deaths of two soldiers and serious injury to an officer.
details: Two soldiers of the Bangladesh Army were killed and an officer was seriously injured in an accident during a routine field firing exercise in Hathazari, Chittagong. The incident occurred when a tank experienced an unexpected explosion or mechanical failure during live firing.
The Inter Services Public Relations (ISPR) confirmed the incident in a press release on Wednesday, September 9. The exercise was pre-scheduled and took place at the Hathazari Field Firing Range.

Rescue teams at the range immediately provided first aid to the injured officer. He was subsequently airlifted to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for advanced and intensive medical treatment.
The ISPR has stated that a thorough investigation into the exact cause of the accident and the mechanical failure is underway, following military regulations.
